bull.b: Early product adoption, expanding prescriber reach and rising patient volume provide a foundation for recurring commercial revenue as awareness, reimbursement and prescribing infrastructure mature.

Positive pivotal data supports extending aficamten into symptomatic non-obstructive HCM, potentially broadening the addressable market and strengthening Cytokinetics’ cardiovascular muscle-biology franchise.

The enlarged cash balance gives Cytokinetics greater capacity to fund commercialization, clinical trials and regulatory work, extending operational flexibility while products and pipeline programs progress.

bear.b: Dependence on irregular licensing and milestone payments makes reported revenue unpredictable, while current product revenue remains relatively small and may not yet offset collaboration-related variability.

Large ongoing cash outflows and widening losses require substantial funding for development and commercialization, increasing the likelihood of continued reliance on financing before profitability is achieved.

Negative equity combined with substantial debt reduces financial flexibility and heightens dependence on capital markets, particularly while the company remains loss-making and its commercial base is developing.
